'''Komnor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet was absorbed into [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]] as [[Xim/Legends|he]] expanded his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]].<ref name="TEA" /> A few years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] met [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] during a [[skirmish near Komnor]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> A vicious warlord later arrived in the system and evicted the Hutts from their home. The homeless Hutts complained to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], who assigned [[Dyyz Nataz]] with the job of [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] the warlord.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|224|Komnor system}}</ref>
